title: Expert call – former sales director at a competitor

paragraphs.text: The expert described the European fleet maintenance software market as fragmented, with many regional vendors and no dominant player.

The expert said they had heard in general market conversations that Larkspur's largest customer may re-tender its maintenance software contract in 2027. Unverified; the expert network confirmed no confidential information was discussed.
The expert considered Larkspur's product strong in scheduling but behind competitors in predictive analytics.
